title: 第5章 镜花水月二次模拟第6章 蜉蝣踏前斩
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 听到叶明月的话，叶枫一头黑线。
“你才吃饲料了，以前只是穿的鞋子底子低，现在穿的正常的，原本我们身高就没有差距太多好吧，不说这个了，我就说想问问你，现在是几号了？距离下个月还有几天？还有跟你订婚的林家姑娘确定好了是谁了吗？”
避免叶明月发现什么，他立马转移了话题。
听到叶枫的话，叶明月的脸就拉了下来。
“唉，别提这个了，我都要愁死了，我才八岁就被父母开始操办着未婚妻，关键是谁都还不清楚。”
叹气之后叶明月告知了叶枫，现在已经是二十七号了，还有三天就到八月了。
听到叶明月的话，叶枫心里一阵欣喜，三天时间对于他们来说很快就能过去。
对于有可能改变自己根骨的模拟，他很是上心。
同时对于叶明月的忧愁也能理解，这个事情他从母亲林兰那边了解到了一些细节，林家那边的高层有看上叶明月天资的人，所以想早早的给人安排，已经是在找天资能与之相配的林家人了，这样在日后叶明月成为叶家的领军人物之后，也能加深林叶两家的关系，两人成年后也能生出更好的下一代。
评价天资，并不只有根骨，而是根骨、特殊体质、悟性与天赋四方面来评断的。
往往男女双方的天资越高，所生下的小孩天资都不会差，甚至更好，但修为越高者便越难生育，所以各大家族的人都会早早的给嫡系弟子找好配对的伴侣。
当然对于叶枫的这种根骨来说，没有人逼迫他就是了，他也不知道这算不算一个好事情。
就这样，叶枫在与叶明月简单的交流之后，拒绝了叶明月想带自己去看斗兽场的要求之后，便向负责练功房的人员申请使用‘镜花水月’的机会，想要测试一下自己如今的实力如何，虽然从属性面板来看，自己的力量比叶明月要高不少，但实际上他更想知道登堂入室级别的憾山拳的威力。
练功房负责人很快就给他选好了洞口，带着他来到了一座地下暗门之中，在跟随负责人进入暗门之后，最终进入了洞口。
叶枫也没有磨叽，按照特定的步骤做了下来，同时闭上了双眼。
半刻钟后，叶枫模糊的意识进入了一个擂台赛场，他这次选择的对手，是叶明月不久前留下的影子，很快，双方就交手起来，交手三招后，他在不使用憾山拳的情况下把叶明月的影子打出了虚拟擂台。
面对这个结果，他果断放弃了继续选择叶明月的想法，选择了一位客家换血境初期的高手。
很快，双方在你来我往之间，交手了五十余招，最终叶枫凭借着憾山拳以自身重伤的情况下把这位客家武者打下了擂台。
在打完后，叶枫很快就回归了现实，长舒一口气“家族的地级灵宝‘镜花水月’很好用，就是可惜自己也只有一次体验机会。”
这还是父亲凭借天字号长老的资格转移给自己的一次机会，只是这样确实很安全就是了，在镜花水月中的一切行为，除去会消耗自己部分心神外，对自己并无影响。
也不会被人探测到自己测试的实力。
而镜花水月也是叶家为数不多的几件地级灵宝，也可称得上家族的传承至宝。
在测试完实力后，叶枫去见了自己的亲生母亲林兰，得知林兰正在闭关，他也没有过多打扰，虽然他知道自己要见的话母亲肯定是会取消闭关的。
但他不能这么自私，拿走林兰为自己准备为期半年用度的草药，这种草药是用于药浴之用，每次苦练之后进行药浴能帮助身体更快修复，也能促进身体成长。
草药虽然只是凡级，对于叶家嫡系来说并非多么珍贵的东西，但也不是一般人用的起的。
取完草药后他就回到了住所，打算在家修炼，直至等到下一次模拟，毕竟这不是模拟中，而是现实世界，胡乱闯祸可能真会出事情。
特别是这种拥有高武的世界，虽然丰元城威胁自己会对他出手的人不多，但很难说会不会有如同黑衣人一样，来自其他地方来的大能，看自己不顺眼把叶枫给解决了。
时间很快就来到了八月，守着时间的叶枫立马看到模拟次数的增加。
【系统，进行模拟。
【检测到上次模拟剩余2评价积分，获得随机低级天赋，天生药心（临时），增加少量药草和丹药的吸收率。
“之前他还想来着，浪费了两点评价分，没想到居然还有这个作用。”
对于系统的识相，他很满意，没有黑心的贪墨自己的积分，换成了另外一种方式补偿自己，这就很舒服，一点都不亏。

content_en:
Hearing Ye Mingyue's words, Ye Feng's head turned black.
"You just started eating. You used to wear shoes with low soles, but now you wear normal ones. Originally, there wasn't much difference in our heights. Okay, let's not talk about it anymore. I just want to ask you, what day is it now? How many days are there until next month? And have you decided who the girl from the Lin family who is engaged to you is?"
To prevent Ye Mingyue from discovering anything, he immediately changed the topic.
Ye Mingyue's face dropped when she heard Ye Feng's words.
"Oh, don't mention this. I'm going to die from worry. My parents started taking care of my fiancée when I was only eight years old. I don't know who the key is yet."
After sighing, Ye Mingyue informed Ye Feng that it was already the 27th, and August would be in three days.
Hearing Ye Mingyue's words, Ye Feng felt happy. Three days would pass quickly for them.
He is very interested in simulations that may change his own bones.
At the same time, he can also understand Ye Mingyue's worries. He learned some details about this matter from his mother Lin Lan. The senior leaders of the Lin family are interested in Ye Mingyue's talent, so they want to arrange for her early. They are already looking for Lin family members with matching talents. This way, after Ye Mingyue becomes the leader of the Ye family in the future, the relationship between the Lin and Ye families can be deepened, and the two of them can give birth to a better next generation when they become adults.
To evaluate talent, it is not just based on one’s basic skills, but one’s basic skills, special physique, understanding and talent.
Often, the higher the talent of both men and women, the more talented the children born will be, or even better. However, the higher the cultivation level, the more difficult it is for the child to have a child. Therefore, people from major families will find matching partners for their direct disciples early.
Of course, for Ye Feng's kind of nature, as long as no one forces him, he doesn't know if this is a good thing.
In this way, after Ye Feng had a simple exchange with Ye Mingyue and rejected Ye Mingyue's request to take him to the Colosseum, he applied to the person in charge of the training room for the opportunity to use the 'Mirror Flower Water Moon' and wanted to test his current strength. Although judging from the attribute panel, his strength was much higher than Ye Mingyue's, but in fact he wanted to know the power of the Tangshan Fist at the level of entering the palace.
The person in charge of the practice room quickly chose the entrance for him and took him to an underground secret door. After following the person in charge into the secret door, he finally entered the entrance of the cave.
Ye Feng didn't hesitate, he followed the specific steps and closed his eyes at the same time.
Half a quarter of an hour later, Ye Feng's vague consciousness entered a ring. The opponent he chose this time was the shadow left by Ye Mingyue not long ago. Soon, the two sides started fighting. After three moves, he knocked Ye Mingyue's shadow out of the virtual ring without using the Hanshan Fist.
Faced with this result, he decisively gave up the idea of ​​continuing to choose Ye Mingyue and chose a master in the early stage of the Hakka Blood Exchange Realm.
Soon, the two sides exchanged more than fifty moves, and finally Ye Feng relied on the Hanshan Fist to knock the Hakka warrior off the ring with serious injuries to himself.
After the fight, Ye Feng quickly returned to reality and breathed a long sigh of relief, "The family's earth-level spiritual treasure 'Jing Hua Shui Yue' is very useful, but it's a pity that I only have one chance to experience it."
This was an opportunity given to him by his father by virtue of his qualifications as an elder of Tianzihao. It was just that it was really safe. All his actions in Mirror Flowers and Water Moon had no impact on him except for consuming part of his mind.
Nor will anyone detect my testing strength.
The Mirror Flower and Water Moon are also one of the few earth-level spiritual treasures in the Ye family, and can also be called the family's inherited treasure.
After testing his strength, Ye Feng went to meet his biological mother Lin Lan. When he learned that Lin Lan was in retreat, he did not disturb her too much, although he knew that his mother would definitely cancel the retreat if he wanted to see her.
But he couldn't be so selfish and take away the herbs that Lin Lan had prepared for him for half a year. These herbs were used for medicinal baths. Taking a medicinal bath after each hard training can help the body repair faster and promote physical growth.
Although the herbs were only ordinary-level and not very precious to the direct descendants of the Ye family, they were not something that ordinary people could afford.
After getting the herbs, he returned to his residence and planned to practice at home until the next simulation. After all, this was not a simulation, but the real world. If you get into trouble randomly, something might really happen.
Especially in this kind of world with high martial arts, although there are not many people in Fengyuan City who threaten themselves to take action against them, it is difficult to say whether there will be powerful people from other places like the men in black who are displeased with themselves and deal with Ye Feng.
Time soon came to August, and Ye Feng, who kept track of time, immediately saw an increase in the number of simulations.
[System, simulate.
[It is detected that there are 2 evaluation points left in the last simulation, and you will get a random low-level talent, natural medicine heart (temporary), and increase the absorption rate of a small amount of herbs and pills.
"He was thinking about it before and wasted two evaluation points, but he didn't expect it to have this effect."
He was very satisfied with the system's understanding. He didn't have a bad intention to save his own points, so he used another way to compensate himself. This was very comfortable and not a loss at all.
